title: The Tortoise and the Hare
description: Slow and steady wins the race.

units.text: A hare was making fun of a tortoise for being so slow.
units.translation: 一只兔子嘲笑乌龟走得太慢。

units.text: "Do you ever get anywhere?" he asked with a laugh.
units.translation: “你到底能不能走到哪儿去啊？”他笑着问。

units.text: "Yes," replied the tortoise, "and I get there sooner than you think."
units.translation: “能，”乌龟回答，“而且比你想的更快。”

units.text: "Let's race and see," said the hare.
The fox agreed to be the judge, and the race began.
units.translation: 狐狸同意当裁判，比赛开始了。

units.text: The hare ran so fast that he was soon far ahead.
units.translation: 兔子跑得飞快，很快就遥遥领先。

units.text: "This is too easy," he thought. "I have time for a nap."
units.translation: “这也太容易了，”他想，“我还有时间睡一觉。”

units.text: So he lay down under a tree and fell asleep.
units.translation: 于是他躺在一棵树下睡着了。

units.text: Meanwhile, the tortoise kept walking, slowly but without stopping.
units.translation: 与此同时，乌龟一直在走，慢，但从不停下。

units.text: When the hare woke up, the tortoise was already near the finish line.
units.translation: 兔子醒来时，乌龟已经快到终点了。

units.text: The hare ran as fast as he could, but it was too late.
units.translation: 兔子拼命地跑，可已经来不及了。

units.text: Slow and steady wins the race.
